lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to use numbers and repeat blocks to solve puzzles with as few blocks as possible.
Some puzzles say “use 3 blocks or fewer”.
Count the blocks in your script.
Right, right, right, right is four!
If a pattern happens again, put it inside a repeat.
Short code is easy to read and easy to fix.
Reach the star with 3 blocks or fewer. The arrows move 1 square.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
